title: Normalize a series of sensor readings
objective: Return a new list of readings clamped into range and rounded to one decimal place, leaving the caller's list untouched.
audience: CS1 students who have been writing list-and-loop code for a few weeks
concepts: names bound to objects rather than to storage
copying a list before changing it
clamping a value into a range
rounding to a fixed number of decimals
empty input as a normal case
misconceptions: `out = readings` binds the same list, so writing through `out` writes into the caller's list
rebinding the loop variable does not write to the list, so the fix looks like it works on a read-back that goes through the same alias
clamping without rounding still returns values the specification rejects
